status: fixed before audit/results/phase10_census.json existed; the only census-wide quantities seen are those already in Phase V-B/IX (Y3 for all rules, Y4 for a 296-rule sample)
already_seen_in_this_phase: FR30 class 1386: Y1..Y4, F1..F4, U0, U1, mu0

objective.target: E_*(r) = inf sigma(H_Y), Y in the hull of rule r, H = 24 - A_U on l^2(Y) x C^2 (infinite volume)
objective.primary: the best certified LOWER bound on E_*(r); for all classes this is max_k F_k (free supertile bottoms, k <= 4); for stage-B candidates also the IMS bound at a common radius
kept_separate: Y_L = lambda_min of the pinned level-L supertile (finite volume, an upper bound on E_*)

stage_B_selection.rule: the 15 classes with the largest Y4, then the 5 classes with the largest F4 not already chosen, plus the mandatory benchmarks (FR30 class, the 937 and 938 classes)
stage_B_selection.deep_computations: Y5 for every stage-B class; Y6 and the chain bounds U2, U3 only for the 5 stage-B classes with the largest Y5 (a second, pre-declared stage)
stage_B_selection.promotion: a candidate is promoted only if it survives: independent operator reconstruction (census builder vs phase9 builder at level 3), eigensolver residual < 1e-8 at its deepest level, a certified level-4 enclosure (exact Rayleigh above, Higham Cholesky below), free-vs-pinned comparison at matched volume, and the last-ratio finite-size baseline
stage_B_selection.not_allowed: choosing a winner from Y3 or Y4 alone; re-selecting after Y6 is seen

part_V_test.unit: gauge classes (one row each); grouped by class by construction; 10-fold CV with fixed seed 20261024
targets: Y5 for a pre-registered random sample of 200 classes (numpy default_rng(20261024).choice over class ids, without replacement) plus nothing selected by outcome

models.M1_local: plaquette class fractions (f_m1, f_trl), two-cycle class fractions, U0, U1, mu0, n_types1
models.M2_loops: M1 + closed-walk moments m2..m8 (level 3) + 2x2 Wilson-loop fractions
models.M3_correlations: M1 + the V-B correlation statistics (Ct_*, Cp_*, pair_m1, cv_*)
models.M4_hierarchy: M1 + M2 + M3 + hierarchy descriptors: depth enrichments enr1..3, hierarchical variances hvar1..2, Phi self-loops, Phi second eigenvalue, frequency of the U1-minimising type

part_V_test.learners: OLS on standardised features and sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor with default hyperparameters (no tuning)
part_V_test.decision: hierarchy adds out-of-sample information only if, for BOTH targets and BOTH learners, the paired bootstrap (2000 resamples of classes) 95% interval of RMSE(best of M1..M3) - RMSE(M4) lies entirely above 0
part_V_test.reported: RMSE with bootstrap intervals, R^2, calibration slope (actual on predicted), the 10 largest residuals with class ids (FR30 and the top-Y4 classes named)
